profiles.name: drum-machine
profiles.text:
# name: drum machine
# publish: yes
# ANALOG 2 for bass, SAMPLE, GRAIN, LOFI, SLICE; every kit, the drum editor, user samples and kits; every FX;
# the icons. Every sample set but STRINGS (it can still be uploaded to a USR slot).
# Off: FM6, DIGITAL, PHASE, VOICE, TRIO, WHEEL.
ENG_DIGITAL=0
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_FM6=0
ENG_SLICE=1
USB_MODE=1
SET_STRGS=0
PATTERNS=1
# 2026-10-18: out to fit again (the firmware grew): FLUTE and HORNS (each can still be uploaded to a USR slot), the PUNCH ring at 0.37 s (pool); the VIEW ALL overview
SET_FLUTE=0
SET_HORNS=0
PUNCH_N=16384

profiles.name: everything-that-fits
profiles.text:
# name: everything fits
# publish: yes
# Every engine, FM6 option, kit, FX and feature; the CDC console (USB audio is EXPERIMENTAL). Out to fit:
# two sample sets, SCRATCH and STRINGS (they can still be uploaded to a USR slot); the PUNCH ring at 0.37 s
# (pool); the LCD's changed-rectangle strips (RAM code). docs/BUILDER.md lists the trade-offs.
USB_MODE=1
SET_SCRCH=0
SET_STRGS=0
PUNCH_N=16384
LCD_DIRTY=0
# the reverb's lines (17 KB) in the pool, which has room here: main RAM is the scarcer (same sound)
REV_POOL=1
# the CZ engine (Melodee 0.11, engine 13): +7.3 KB flash, +3.2 KB RAM, +32 B RAM code here
ENG_CZ=1
# the knob's help line on the top bar (tools/param_help.json): +6.4 KB flash, no RAM, no RAM code
PARAM_HELP=1
# 2026-10-18: out to fit again (the firmware grew): FLUTE (it can still be uploaded to a USR slot); TRIO (RAM code); the web editor's live editing (backup / restore stay); the SLICER's capture halved (pool); DUCK (RAM code)
SET_FLUTE=0
ENG_TRIO=0
ED_LIVE=0
SL_LEN=2048
FX_DUCK=0

profiles.name: synth
profiles.text:
# name: Synth
# publish: yes
# Optimist Synth: the maintainer's own build, and the default profile (tools/optimist.py, make, the builder's start, the Pages site).
# 2026-10-18: the maintainer's own configuration (config/my-profiles/mots.config) as it is: flash 566,112 of 581,564 B, RAM 95,400 of 98,304.
# Against the previous Synth: the web editor's live editing items (ED_LIVE, ED_MIX, ED_SEQ, ED_SCREENS) are off (the editor still backs up and restores), three more FM6 voice packs, NATIVE_BANKS, FUZZ / HARM / SUBOCT / SFOLD / RING, ENERGY, PARAM_HELP, the 8 KB undo reserve.
# firmware builder configuration (tools/builder/registry.py keys; others take their defaults)
# Reserve
RESERVE_UNDO_KB=8
# Synth engines
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_LOFI=0
ENG_SAMPLE=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_GRAIN=0
FM6_PK_KEYS=1

SET_BASS=0

SET_HORNS=0
SET_STRGS=0
SET_FLUTE=0
SET_SCRCH=0
# FX: any number (each track its own)
FX_SLICER=0
FX_DUST=0
TRK_FILT=1
INS_FOLD=1
INS_FUZZ=1
INS_WIDTH=1
INS_SFOLD=1
INS_HARM=1
INS_RING=1

INS_GATER=1

FX_DUCK=0

PUNCH_LATCH=1
# Sequencer

PATTERNS=1

REC_MODES=1

profiles.name: x0x-drums
profiles.text:
# name: x0x drums
# publish: no
# The drum machine with both X0X kits (909 with its ride and crash samples, 808). Out to fit
# them: the five sampled kits (ACOUSTIC .. DUST; the 32 synthesised kits stay), the PIANO, HORNS and FLUTE
# sets (STRINGS as in drum-machine; each can still be uploaded to a USR slot), the delay at 0.74 s (pool).
# Synth engines
ENG_DIGITAL=0
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_FM6=0
ENG_SLICE=1
# Drums
DRUM_SAMPLED=0
DRUM_X0X909=1
DRUM_X0X808=1
# Sample sets
SET_PIANO=0
SET_HORNS=0
SET_STRGS=0
SET_FLUTE=0
# FX
DLY_LEN=32768
# MIDI & USB
USB_MODE=1
# the reverb's lines (17 KB) in the pool, which has room here: main RAM is the scarcer (same sound)
REV_POOL=1
PATTERNS=1
# 2026-10-15 (batch 158, the web editor): this profile fills the slot to the byte; the web editor's FX-slot, favorites, oscilloscope and song-chain commands are OFF here so it links
ED_MIX=1
ED_SEQ=1
ED_SCREENS=1
# 2026-10-18: out to fit again (the firmware grew): VIBES (it can still be uploaded to a USR slot)
SET_VIBES=0
